cross_cutting_rules: Q-hook is LANE-SPECIFIC: wins in anxiety/cognitive/evening-relaxation/burnout; DIES in morning/sleep/daytime-calm. Never default it.
Compact (2-3 words) beats verbose in any Q-hook (#35).
Slot-2 needs search intent, not poetry (#36).
Permission ('IT'S OKAY TO REST') is a real winning format in stress/burnout/rest.
Thumbnail instrument MUST match title instrument (2 live violations: XSIsS9ZZgLg violin-as-dilruba, KeEFFkaCMRk tabla-as-santoor).
Vary format across consecutive ships (channel-page pattern blindness).
Low AVD != bad music by default: check sleep-lane (expected), runtime mismatch, or title-promise mismatch first.
